Minimum of 3–5 years experience in employee relations, labor relations, or general HR administration.
Prior experience in higher education or a public sector organization adhering to UC system policies and union contracts.
Practical experience conducting workplace investigations and drafting clear, legally compliant disciplinary documentation.
Experience facilitating department-level change initiatives and employee engagement programs.
Advise leadership and staff on employee relations matters, policy interpretation, collective bargaining agreement administration, and dispute resolution.
Conduct workplace investigations into employee concerns, prepare disciplinary documentation, and support grievance handling and resolution processes.
Assist client department managers with routine organizational adjustments, position description updates, and HR data collection to support operational needs.
Support departmental engagement efforts, help managers utilize performance management tools, and guide employees toward professional development resources.
Solid understanding of employment laws, personnel policies, and labor agreements with strong problem-solving and communication skills.
Familiarity with supporting compensation actions, benefit program inquiries, and talent acquisition processes.
